scalar_boundary: Finite physical additivity alone yields no arbitrary real vector space. The audited linear diagnostic is the already-declared Map(K_R,Q), using formal signed singleton grades. Extension to R is mathematical and conditional; physical realization is unresolved.

objects.name: lineage
objects.definition: A common Genesis identifier g and finite nonempty prefix-closed set X of unique finite words with empty root.
objects.type: Finite rooted addressed set; no scalar structure needed.
assumptions: full structural addresses, not hashes alone

objects.name: incidence
objects.definition: For every nonroot word v include its immediate-prefix parent edge. In atom coordinates each incidence row has -1 at parent and +1 at child.
objects.type: Combinatorial edge relation; B:F^X->F^edges in the linear diagnostic.

objects.name: admissible pruning
objects.definition: (g,X)->(g,Y) with Y an actual root-containing prefix-closed subset of X.
objects.type: Retained set morphism, not an arbitrary equal-size carrier identification.

objects.name: ancestral retraction
objects.definition: r_XY(x) is the longest prefix of x retained in Y.

objects.name: retained inclusion
objects.definition: i_YX(y)=y for each literally retained identity.
objects.status: supplied by actual retained subset, not an arbitrary complement

objects.name: source spaces
objects.definition: F_X=F-valued signed singleton grades on X; S_X is the kernel of total summation. F=Q, with separately stated conditional R extension.
objects.type: F_X=F^X; S_X subset F_X. Neither is identified with potentials modulo constants.
assumptions: explicit inherited signed linear diagnostic, not physical-grade additivity alone
objects.status: conditional inherited linear representation; physical realization unresolved

objects.name: source section
objects.definition: I_YX zero-extends the singleton grades along i_YX; P_XY I_YX=id.
provenance: actual retained inclusion L5; new explicit linear extension in PROOFS.md P2
objects.status: derived here from supplied inclusion; not assumed as arbitrary splitting

objects.name: cumulative kernels
objects.definition: K_j=ker P_0j for a nested retained chain; K_0=0.
objects.type: Nested F-subspaces of S_X0, with fixed initial carrier.

objects.name: associated grade
objects.definition: gr_j=K_j/K_(j-1) with its quotient equivalence, not a chosen set of representatives.
objects.status: standard quotient construction; bare and retained categories separated

objects.name: inherited Laplacian
objects.definition: L_X=B^t B for the fixed unweighted parent-child incidence convention.
objects.type: L_X:F_X->S_X; induced isomorphism W_X->S_X for a connected tree.
objects.status: inherited diagnostic, not a newly selected physical law

objects.name: centering
objects.status: recovered computational representative, not q_X or source pushforward

objects.name: response quotient
objects.type: q_X:F_X->W_X=F_X/F1_X. W_X and its centered representatives are isomorphic, not identical definitions.
objects.status: derived quotient; legacy Q indexed and disambiguated

objects.name: Green and response maps
objects.definition: G_X=(L_X+11^t/n)^(-1)-11^t/n; T_X=q_X G_X restricted to S_X.
objects.status: recovered actual linear operator; properties proved

objects.name: actual obstruction
objects.definition: O_XY=T_X restricted to ker P_XY; cumulative O_0j=T_X0 restricted to K_j.
objects.status: actual inherited restriction; not replaced by stage pullback

objects.name: response restriction
objects.type: R_XY:W_X->W_Y induced by raw potential restriction S_XY:F_X->F_Y.

objects.name: response lift
objects.definition: H_YX([psi])=[psi composed with r_XY]; raw lift h is constant on ancestral fibers.
provenance: derived from recovered ancestral retraction L4; edge-cancellation argument in PROOFS.md P6
objects.status: derived here and compared with actual Green response, not a new physical transport axiom
